name: vertical_relation
description: Infer whether an object is above or below another from a stated vertical relation; control copies the explicitly stated relation.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[]; control=[]
objects=['red cube','blue ball','green box','gold star','black ring','white cone','silver disk','orange cup']
for i in range(120):
 a,b=random.sample(objects,2); r=random.choice(['above','below']); reverse=bool(i%2)
 x,y=(b,a) if reverse else (a,b)
 ans=({'above':'below','below':'above'}[r] if reverse else r)
 context=f'The {a} is {r} the {b}. '
 items.append({'prompt':context+f'Is the {x} above or below the {y}? Answer:', 'answer':' '+ans})
 control.append({'prompt':context+'Which relation word is explicitly written in the sentence? Answer:', 'answer':' '+r})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
